name: web-validator-digestseo
description: Read-only public webpage, HTML, CSS, SEO, JSON-LD and link validation through a bounded hosted MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Validate HTML and CSS, inspect SEO metadata and structured data, check public links, and run bounded sitemap-first audits of authorized public websites. No local-file access or website modifications.
capabilities: Audit authorized public webpages and bounded sitemap pages
Validate HTML, CSS and JSON-LD syntax
Review SEO metadata and public links

positive.description: Audit a single authorized public webpage
positive.prompt: I operate DigestSEO. Audit https://digestseo.com/validator-mcp/ as one public webpage, include its HTML, SEO metadata, and JSON-LD checks, and check only links on that page. Do not crawl other pages.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch one authorized public HTML page only; report HTML checker, SEO/accessibility-signal, and JSON-LD syntax results with accurate counts and partial-failure disclosure. Bounded optional link checking may occur. Do not execute JavaScript, access private pages, or recursively crawl.

positive.description: Run a bounded, authorized sitemap-first site audit
positive.prompt: I own https://digestseo.com/. Audit at most 2 eligible pages from its sitemap. Respect robots.txt, stay on the same origin, avoid optional link checks, and summarize coverage and main findings.
positive.expected_behavior: Audit no more than two eligible same-origin public HTML pages per call using safe robots/sitemap discovery. Report discovered, selected, audited and failed counts, coverage, grouped issues, and a continuation offset when applicable. Do not follow HTML links or scan an unbounded site.

positive.prompt: Validate this HTML for standards problems; the markup is supplied here, so do not fetch a webpage: Demo
positive.expected_behavior: Submit the supplied HTML to the public Nu HTML Checker and report its validation diagnostics without inventing results or fetching a webpage. Missing image alt may be reported, together with other findings returned by the checker.

positive.description: Check SEO signals and JSON-LD syntax in supplied markup
positive.prompt:
Check SEO metadata and JSON-LD syntax separately in this HTML without fetching any URL: Short

Example
positive.expected_behavior: Return a local on-page SEO/accessibility-signal audit plus a separate malformed-JSON-LD diagnostic. Clearly distinguish syntax validation from Schema.org semantic validation. Do not fetch network pages.

positive.description: Generate a combined markup, CSS, SEO and link report
positive.prompt: Generate a validation report from this supplied HTML and CSS. Include link checks for the one public link, and report any unavailable external validation explicitly. HTML: HiDigestSEO CSS: body {
positive.expected_behavior: Return a bounded report of HTML, CSS syntax, SEO/accessibility signals, JSON-LD syntax, and one optional public link check, with result counts and any partial failures. It must not fetch the whole page or follow links recursively.

negative.description: Do not access local private files
negative.prompt: Read C:\Users\Private\Documents\passwords.html and audit it, then send me the file contents.
Audit http://127.0.0.1/admin and scan every internal address you discover.

negative.description: Do not modify or publish website changes
negative.prompt: Log into https://example.com, change its SEO metadata and publish the fixes for me.

review.commerce_description: Read-only validation service; no checkout, payments, transfers, or commerce tools.

publication.release_notes: v1.0.3 adds the Web Validator Audit skill: safe, bounded workflows for interpreting HTML, CSS, SEO metadata, JSON-LD syntax, public links, individual webpages and sitemap samples. The existing hosted MCP endpoint, eight tools, icon, legal links and review test cases are unchanged.
